For Honor: Year 10 Season 3 - BLOOD HUNT GAMEPLAY TRAILER
Blood Hunt season officially opens on September 10th, 2026. 

The Keeper of Chains Hero Skin for Conqueror and Ranked: Dominion will be available on September 10th, 2026.

About For Honor:
Step into the battlefield to experience the chaos and glory found only in For Honor. 

Whether battling through a gripping campaign or clashing with others in intense multiplayer modes and PvP modes, players choose from history’s deadliest warriors, each from a fierce rival faction — the bold Knights, the brutal Vikings, the deadly Samurai, the fearsome Wu Lin, and the enigmatic Outlanders. 

For Honor is a fast-paced and immersive experience that continues to evolve with major gameplay updates, new Heroes, thrilling events, and more, keeping the conflict alive and ever challenging.

#Ubisoft #ForHonor

Riders Republic: Scooter Behind the Scenes
Two iconic champions helped the Riders Republic team bring the Scooter to life. Coming October 7.

About Riders Republic:
Live out the rider's fantasy as you roam free in a huge, vibrant open world, always buzzing with other players around you. Immerse yourself in iconic American national parks including Bryce Canyon, Yosemite Valley, Mammoth Mountain... all mashed up for you to shred! Squad up with your friends and compete in a wide range of multiplayer modes: feel the rush of downhill races, dominate maps in team vs team competitions, or give it your best shot in epic mass PvP races with 50+ other players.
